name: Midas mF-ONE
oneLiner: mF-ONE is a Midas tokenized certificate wrapping Fasanara's F-ONE private-credit and digital-asset strategy; NAV-accreting, EEA-restricted rails.
collateral: Fasanara F-ONE strategy exposure through Midas tokenized certificate rails, including fintech receivables, SME lending, real-estate-backed credit, and digital-asset strategies.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting Midas liquid-yield token; primary issuance and redemption occur through Midas permissioned rails rather than a fixed $1 peg.

proofOfReserves.provider: Midas transparency dashboard and issuer disclosures

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes: Midas mF-ONE is a permissioned tokenized certificate with issuer/admin control surfaces around minting, redemption, transfer administration, and upgradeable protocol contracts.

params.assetLabel: Fasanara F-ONE private-credit and digital-asset strategy NAV

mintAuthority.summary: mF-ONE is a Midas tokenized certificate; new units are minted only by Midas's permissioned issuance role (MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE) when greenlisted users deposit through the Midas DepositVault, with NAV conversion settled off-chain by the issuer.

controls.label: Midas issuance manager (MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE / DepositVault)
controls.evidence: Midas vault architecture mints the certificate token via a permissioned MINT_OPERATOR_ROLE through the DepositVault against greenlisted deposits; conversion rate is set off-chain by the issuer and token/vault contracts are upgradeable behind MidasAccessControl.

review.evidence: Midas certificates are minted and redeemed exclusively through Midas's permissioned DepositVault/RedemptionVault contracts gated by MidasAccessControl roles (greenlist + mint operator); no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists. On-chain owner/role holders not independently read.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the live on-chain MidasAccessControl role holders (mint operator, default admin) and proxy admin before raising confidence.
